User Story: As a student, I want to log in so that I can access my library account.
As a librarian, I want to add books so that students can borrow them.
As a student, I want to search books by title so that I can find available books.
As a student, I want to borrow books so that I can read them.
As a student, I want to return borrowed books so that my record is updated.
As a librarian, I want to update book information so that records remain accurate.
As a librarian, I want to generate reports so that I can monitor library activities.
As an administrator, I want to manage user accounts so that only authorized users can access the system.
As a student, I want to view my borrowing history so that I can track the books I have borrowed.
